_about: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for WHAT we say (marketing). Content skills decide HOW we say it (hook, retention, captions, video). Every script, caption, carousel and video plan reads this file. If the two ever disagree, this file wins.
icp: Small business owner in India who talks to customers on WhatsApp, Instagram or phone (shop, cafe, gym, clinic, coaching centre, salon, hotel, D2C brand), busy, not technical, loses enquiries when they cannot reply fast. Lead-gen posts instead speak to freelancers, agencies and solo service sellers who need clients from local businesses.
positioning: A solo Indian web developer (AR Designs) who builds simple, honest digital tools for small businesses and shows how they work in plain Hinglish. Teaches first, sells last.
pains: customer messages at night and the reply comes the next morning, so the customer goes elsewhere
the same questions (timings, rates, location) answered again and again by hand
no website or a website that is slow on a phone, so customers cannot find or trust the business
enquiries scattered across chats and lost
freelancers and agencies spend hours searching for prospects by hand

funnel.goal: earn a comment, then a DM. One reel or carousel does one job: give the owner something worth staying for (a surprising, useful fact), make them recognise their own situation, then ask for ONE public comment of the keyword; the freebie is sent to their DM.

beat_roles.poke: awareness: why the obvious fix fails
beat_roles.payoff: consideration: what it means for the owner (verified fact only)
beat_roles.cta: decision: 'Comment KEYWORD' and the one freebie they get in their DM

funnel.hook_beat_never_contains: price, brand name, the DM keyword, an offer

pillars.note: Calendar split from content-strategy (60/30/10), adapted: no testimonials or client results exist, so there is no 'proof' pillar.

educate.job: explain a problem or how a tool works so it is useful even if they never DM

how_it_works.job: show the steps of the service in plain words, no sales push

offer.job: invite the comment directly; the only pillar that may say 'Comment' in the hook area of a caption

offers_allowed: a one-page checklist for the service, sent in the DM after the viewer comments the keyword (the files are in freebies/)
pay after approval: the client pays only after approving the work
a short DM conversation with honest advice on whether the service fits the business
website posts only: a free quick look at a website with 3 things to fix
claims_rules: Say what the service does (capabilities in services.json), never what result the owner will get.
No testimonials, client names, results or statistics except verified facts cited by id.
Say 'can help', 'makes it easier', 'reduces'; never an absolute.
voice: Plain Hinglish in Roman letters for Instagram and video, simple English for LinkedIn and Bluesky. A developer talking to a shop owner. Specific nouns and times, short sentences next to a longer explaining one. Honest about limits.
ai_tells_forbidden: contrast reveals ('it is not X, it is Y')
negation lists ('No X, no Y, no Z')
stock phrases (say goodbye to, unlock the power, game-changer, take it to the next level, here's the thing, let that sink in)

website.gets: a one-page checklist: 10 things a customer judges your website on, with an honest note on whether you need a new one

chatbot.gets: a one-page checklist: the 10 questions a WhatsApp reply bot should answer for your business, so you can see if it fits

animated_ads.gets: a one-page checklist: what a 20-second ad must show so a customer understands your business, in order

lead_gen.gets: a one-page checklist: how to pick the 20 local businesses worth contacting first and what to say in the first message

reel_scripts.gets: a one-page checklist: the 5 lines every business reel script needs, and a fill-in template

seo_blogs.gets: a one-page checklist: 12 questions your customers type into Google, and how to turn each into a blog post

curiosity: CURIOSITY FIRST: every reel gives the viewer something they did not know and would repeat to a friend (a surprising fact, a feature most owners miss, a before/after, what customers silently judge). The hook opens a gap; each beat closes one piece and opens the next; the payoff delivers it. Only verified facts or capabilities; a real study is named only if it is on the fact sheet. Never a bare feature list, never a lecture.
